recognize_zh: 低倍下可見大量顆粒球，從骨髓球、後骨髓球到帶狀核與分葉核都有，呈左移的顆粒球增生，但嗜鹼性球與單核球不明顯，高倍才能細看發育不良；需配合 BCR-ABL1 陰性。
features: Markedly increased granulocytic cells at low power
Full spectrum of maturation: occasional blasts/promyelocytes, many myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Some neutrophils appear hypogranular with irregular nuclear segmentation
Dysplastic detail limited by low magnification
describe_en: Smear at low magnification shows a markedly increased population of granulocytic cells spanning all stages of maturation, including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils, with few blasts. Some neutrophils appear hypogranular with irregular nuclear lobation, although dysplastic features are difficult to assess fully at this power. Basophils and monocytes are not prominent. In the context of BCR-ABL1-negative leukocytosis, findings are consistent with atypical chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: CML shows absolute basophilia and a myelocyte peak with little dysplasia, and is defined by BCR-ABL1.
Leukemoid reactions show toxic granulation and Döhle bodies with normal granulation and segmentation and a clear reactive cause.
CMML has sustained monocytosis ≥10% of leukocytes, which is not seen in this field.
